work.what: For the corrected CHHL prime-pair problem (see CORRECTED_RH_BRIDGE.md and LOCALIZED_MIXED_ENERGY.md in hunts/prime_pair_error/), prove or disprove a power-saving mean-square bound for the long window A(k) = sum_{n<=k} (Lambda(n) - a(n)), where Lambda is the von Mangoldt function (including proper prime powers) and a(n) = nu(n)(1 - 1_exc * chi(n) * n^{beta-1}) is the Tao-Teravainen sieve model (nu(n) = b_Z * 1_{(n,P(Z))=1}, Z = exp((log N)^{1/10}), P(Z) = product of primes below Z, b_Z = P(Z)/phi(P(Z)); chi, beta the primitive real character and real zero of an assumed Siegel exceptional zero, absent if none exists). Specifically, for some fixed eta > 0, is it true that 2*sum_{k=1}^{N-1} (A(k) - A(N)/2)^2 + (N+1)/2 * A(N)^2 << N^{3-eta} unconditionally? The only bound currently established for this quantity is O(N^3 * exp(-c * (log N)^{3/5} * (log log N)^{-1/5})) via the classical (Vinogradov-Korobov) prime number theorem, which is N^{3-o(1)}, not a fixed power saving. Report which of the two outcomes (a fixed-eta bound, or a proof that no such eta exists via a Landau-Omega-type obstruction from an actual or hypothetical Siegel zero) holds, or name the exact point the argument fails if neither can be settled.

For the corrected CHHL prime-pair problem (see LOCALIZED_MIXED_ENERGY.md in hunts/prime_pair_error/, its Section 6 and equation 22), determine the sign or size of the two cross terms 2*Re<X,Y> and 2*Re<X+Y,R_mod> in the exact expansion ||G_corr||_2^2 = ||X||_2^2 + ||Y||_2^2 + ||R_mod||_2^2 + 2*Re<X,Y> + 2*Re<X+Y,R_mod>, where X = C(2*Re(conj(H)*W)), Y = C(|W|^2), R_mod = C(|H|^2 - V_y) - C_N_hat (C the operator removing the constant Fourier coefficient, W = F - H the difference between the von Mangoldt exponential sum F and its Tao-Teravainen sieve-model exponential sum H, V_y the truncated singular-series polynomial at y = floor(sqrt(N)), C_N_hat the exceptional-zero correction polynomial). No sign or cancellation estimate for these two terms has been proved anywhere in this hunt; the current budget (LOCALIZED_MIXED_ENERGY.md eq 25) bounds them away via triangle inequality only, at cost of the eq 20 gap above. Report whether cancellation between X, Y, R_mod can be established (even conditionally, e.g. under a zero-density hypothesis), or name the specific obstruction if it cannot.
